message: carries `ROLE` — Angular sets a name there as written
$reason: The reference's error drawn as an SVG `<text>`, its role written `ROLE="alert"`; the parser names the element `:svg:text`. Angular sets a name on such an element as written, and `setAttribute` keeps its case there, so in the browser the text carries an attribute `ROLE`, no role, and announces nothing; its server renderer writes the name into the page as it stands, and the browser's HTML parser lowers it, so after hydration it carries `role="alert"` (measured on 2026-10-19: Chromium 153, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6, the page from Angular 22.2's `renderApplication`). Read lowered, as the walk read every name, it passed; read as written, it would pass the page the server rendered. A name the gate reads, in capitals on an element of a foreign namespace, fails point 1.
